intent: The services marketplace is browse, save and enquire only in the MVP (ADR 0007, journeys-ia): categories, vendor lists, a vendor profile, and a structured quote request that opens a vendor chat. There is no vendor checkout, payment or availability calendar. Vendor imagery never shows people (equipment, decor details, hand patterns, palettes). Reached through the Venues | Services switch on Discover Home and the My Wedding tools row.

screens.purpose: The Additional services hub for post-venue needs: five primary categories (Hospitality and catering, Buffet services, Floral arrangements, Event styling and decor, Event planning and coordination) as large tiles, then "More services" (the secondary categories) as a compact list, a planner entry card and a way back to venues. Also where the governmental-facility "Find catering and decor" link lands.
interactions: Planner card 'Wedding planner, from KD 650' opens the packages (CL-PLAN-01); a 'Saved vendors' row opens Saved > Services
Heart count and a quiet 'Add to budget' hint appear on vendor cards later, not here

Venues | Additional services switch at the top returns to Home; five 4:5 primary tiles (image with a subtle scrim and a text label, no coloured chips) open the category list (CL-SERV-02); "More services" lists the secondary categories (photography and videography, cake, DJ and MC, henna and makeup, dress and suit rental, cars, invitations, travel) as hairline rows
Each primary tile shows the count of approved providers and "Voucher prices available"; categories render from data (Super Admin managed), so a new category needs no new screen
screens.contentNotes: Groups (AR / EN): «التصوير والفيديو» Photography and video; «الورد والكيك» Flowers and cake; «الدي جي والمذيع والموسيقى الحية» DJ, MC and live music; «الحناء ومكياج العروس» Henna and bridal makeup; «فستان الزفاف وتأجير البدلات» Wedding dress and suit rental; «السيارات الفاخرة وبطاقات الدعوة» Luxury cars and invitations; «الفنادق والسفر وشهر العسل» Hotels, travel and honeymoon (hotels here means guest or bridal-suite accommodation, not wedding venues). Imagery: camera equipment on a table, floral arrangement, speakers and instruments, henna patterns on hands only, a dress on a hanger, a classic car, a suitcase; no faces. A category with no vendors yet reads 'No vendors yet' instead of hiding. Government hall links arrive with the line 'Find catering and decor for a hall-only booking'. Vendor decoration, catering and entertainment companies beyond the PRD list are deferred (CA-SVC-12). Tab bar visible. Voucher model (ADR 0033): primary labels AR / EN: «الضيافة والتموين» Hospitality and catering; «خدمات البوفيه» Buffet services; «تنسيق الورد» Floral arrangements; «التنسيق والديكور» Event styling and decor; «تخطيط المناسبات والتنسيق» Event planning and coordination. The seven groups of the earlier hub become the secondary list. CA-SVC-12 is un-deferred.

screens.purpose: Vendors in one category with name, rating, starting price and photos, plus area, price and rating filters and sort.
interactions: Category header with sibling categories as hairline chips; filter chips for Area, Price and Rating plus a Sort button
Filtered-empty state offers 'Clear filters'; a category with no vendors reads 'No vendors yet' and points to sibling categories
Pull to refresh; position kept when returning

Provider card: 4:5 cover (work, never a face), name, area, rating with count, price line "Voucher from KD 400 · Standard from KD 450" with the unit, heart (saves to Saved > Services); "Sponsored" label only on paid placements; tap opens the profile (CL-SERV-03); only approved, active listings appear
screens.contentNotes: Photography list: «استوديو لمحة للتصوير» / Lamha Photography Studio, Salmiya, 4.7 (58), 'From KD 450'; «عدسة الخليج للتصوير» / Gulf Lens Studio, Jabriya, 4.5 (31), 'From KD 600'; «ضوء للإنتاج المرئي» / Daw Video Production, Shuwaikh, 4.6 (44), 'From KD 700' (videography); a new vendor shows «جديد» / New. Price anchors by category: photography 450 – 900, videography 400 – 900, bridal makeup 150 – 450, henna 80 – 250, cake 150 – 600, DJ 250 – 600, MC 200 – 500, luxury cars 120 – 400, invitations from KD 0.800 per card (price units always stated). A 'female photographer for ladies' halls' tag appears as a plain fact on relevant vendors. Tab bar visible. Voucher model (ADR 0033): list prices become voucher and standard pairs (illustrative seed, fixtures request pending); providers without a voucher price show one price.

screens.purpose: Description, portfolio, packages with prices, reviews and an honest availability line for one vendor. Actions: Request quote, Save, Add to budget.
interactions: Portfolio gallery opens the shared photo viewer; bilingual description; packages as rows with name, inclusions and price
Availability line: 'Availability is confirmed by the vendor in chat' with an 'Ask about Thu 14 Jan' chip that pre-fills the quote request (there is no vendor calendar in the MVP)
Reviews show only when they exist; a new vendor shows «جديد» / New

Packages as rows with name, inclusions and two prices (Standard, Voucher) on the same unit; sticky bar: primary "Get voucher · KD 2" (opens CL-VCHR-01 bound to the package), secondary "Request a quote" (CL-SERV-04, no voucher needed), tertiary "Contact" (browse-only path: chat for registered users); heart saves; "Add to budget" opens the add-expense sheet
screens.contentNotes: Demo: Lamha Photography Studio. Packages: 'Wedding-day coverage · 6 hours' KD 450; '8 hours + album' KD 650; 'Full day + album + highlight video' KD 900; each states what is included and the unit (per event). Portfolio shows hall details, decor, table settings and equipment; no identifiable faces, no alcohol. Female-photographer note: 'Female photographers available for ladies' halls.' Guests may browse everything; the sign-in sheet opens at Request quote with 'to request a quote'. Tab bar visible.

screens.purpose: A short structured enquiry that becomes a card in a new vendor chat thread. Hard-gated, with everything typed preserved through sign-in.
interactions: Prefilled chips: service or package, event date, venue, guests; one free-text note (dir=auto)
Send creates (or reopens) the vendor thread with a structured request card and lands in it (CL-MSGS-02)
Guests see the sign-in sheet at Send with the context line 'to request a quote'
Success copy states that replies arrive in Messages

An optional line "Attach your voucher" shows when the client holds a ready voucher for this provider; attaching turns the enquiry into a request at the voucher price (the provider answers Accept, Decline or Propose another date)
screens.contentNotes: Example: Lamha Photography Studio, 'Wedding-day coverage · 6 hours', «الخميس 14 يناير 2027», Aurelia Gulf Hotel, 350 guests (ladies' hall), note «نحتاج مصوّرة فقط للحفل النسائي». Success: 'Request sent to Lamha Photography Studio. Replies arrive in Messages.' Vendors have no checkout in the MVP. Tab bar hidden while the sheet is open.
